name: Naruto (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Naruto city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a spiral, like a whirlpool.
history: Municipal flag of Naruto, a city in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 7 November 1947.

features.role: Naruto city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a spiral, like a whirlpool
